premises.text: Customer service is widely poor across airlines, hotels, retail, restaurants, and similar venues
Mobile app lets people rate individual service interactions with thumbs, comments, social share, and optional response requests in about 30 seconds
premises.evidence_span: empower people to rate customer service on their cell phones

premises.text: Consumers can look up employee ratings before an interaction to choose whom to deal with
premises.evidence_span: before you went down to the car dealership, you could find out something about the people who are selling you the product

premises.text: Business dashboard aggregates ratings, peer comparison, employee performance, and customer-response inbox
premises.evidence_span: provide a portal, essentially, a dashboard for businesses

premises.text: Distribution via app stores, social promotion, location-app integrations, and partner POS buttons/signs that invite ratings
premises.evidence_span: partners, and we've already started a bunch of conversations with airlines and hotels and restaurant chains and retailers

value.text: Raise the bar on customer service by shining a light on rated interactions so service improves
value.evidence_span: raising the bar on customer service

causal_links.evidence_span: by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better
at a glance see what's going on with their business

notes: REI/airline/dealer demos folded as rating-system cascade (§4.1.7). Pre-visit employee lookup kept as distinct consumer JTBD under tie-break. Investor shout-outs excluded (§4.2).
